Arena Elements

Furniture and passive buffs to set up in the arena before you summon.

Core three: Campfire + Heart Lantern + Bast Statue. The Campfire and Heart Lantern add about +1.5 HP/s regen and multiply healing by 1.1×, and the Bast Statue adds +5 defense.
Heart statues: place as many as you can and wire them to a 1/4 or 1/8 second timer.

How This Guide Works

The game is divided into stages, one for each major boss. Complete the to-do list, collect the gear, then defeat the boss to move on. Every stage has a button that opens the best setup for your class.

Pick A Class

There are four ways to fight: Melee (swords and yoyos), Ranged (bows and guns), Magic (staffs that use mana) and Summoner (minions that fight for you). You can switch at any time, so choose the one that looks most enjoyable. If you are unsure, compare all four in Class Setups.

Pick A Difficulty

Classic is the normal game. Expert makes bosses stronger but gives better loot. Master is the hardest. For a first world, Classic is a good choice.

1
Stage 1 of 10

Getting Started

Survive your first nights, build a home and get your first real tools.

ActiveDone

You start with only basic tools. This stage covers your first day and night: Gathering wood, building a shelter, and finding the gear that makes exploring much easier.

To do

  1. Chop down trees with your Copper Axe until you have at least 100 Wood. You will need it for almost everything early on.
  2. Craft a Work Bench from 10 Wood. While standing near it, you can craft more items, such as a Wooden Sword, a Wooden Bow and Wooden Arrows.
  3. Build a small house before your first night. NPCs (friendly characters such as the Guide and the Merchant) need a house to live in. See Building Houses for NPCs below
  4. Collect Gel from slimes, then craft at least 20 Torches from Gel and Wood. Stay inside during your first night, because Zombies and Demon Eyes come out in the dark.
  5. Dig down with your Copper Pickaxe and mine ore. Build a Furnace from Stone, Wood and Torches to turn ore into bars, then build an Iron Anvil (or a Lead Anvil) to make tools and armor. See Your world's ores below
  6. Drink a Spelunker Potion when you explore caves. It makes ores, chests and Life Crystals glow, even through walls. These potions can be found in underground chests and pots, and slimes underground sometimes carry one.
  7. Find and use at least 3 Life Crystals (the red hearts underground). Each one increases your max health by 20.
  8. Explore underground and open chests until you have a Magic Mirror and a movement item such as Hermes Boots or a Cloud in a Bottle.
  9. Make your first armor at a Work Bench: Cactus armor (cut Cactus in the desert) or Wood armor. Even a small amount of defense helps a lot early on.

Tips

  • Classic is the normal game: Enemies deal their listed damage.On Expert, enemies deal about twice as much damage and have more health. Bosses drop Treasure Bags containing special Expert items.On Master, enemies deal about three times as much damage and have even more health. You receive a 6th accessory slot right away, and bosses drop Treasure Bags plus a Relic trophy.
  • Talk to the Guide. He can tell you what you can craft with any item.
  • Collect a Hook from Skeletons underground. Craft it with 3 chains to make a Grappling Hook, which makes moving around much easier.
  • Collect Fallen Stars at night. Five of them make a Mana Crystal.
  • Ropes and some platforms make it easy to climb back out of deep holes.
  • Collect Shackles from Zombies at night (2% chance each). Every accessory comes with a random modifier, so it is worth collecting a few. On Classic, keep the one labeled Menacing (more damage). Keep the one labeled Warding (+4 defense): Enemies hit much harder on this difficulty, so defense matters more than damage. You cannot reforge items until the Goblin Tinkerer moves in.

New NPCs to look for

MerchantMove-In Condition: Carry 50 silver in your inventorySells torches, rope, healing potions and a Bug Net for catching critters (which you can later use as fishing bait). Buy a Piggy Bank from him as soon as possible: Coins stored in it stay safe when you die.
DemolitionistMove-In Condition: Have the Merchant living with you and carry an explosive, like a BombSells Bombs and Dynamite. Blasting through stone is a very fast way to dig and find ore.
NurseMove-In Condition: Have the Merchant living with you and reach 120 max healthHeals you instantly for a few coins. Very useful between boss attempts.
Arms DealerMove-In Condition: Carry a gun or bulletsSells guns and ammo. A good choice if you want to try Ranged.
Dye TraderMove-In Condition: Carry a dye or a dye plant, and have 4 NPCs living with youMakes dyes so you can change the color of your armor.
AnglerMove-In Condition: Find him asleep on the beach at either end of the world and talk to himGives you a fishing quest every day, with useful rewards.
StylistMove-In Condition: Find her tied up in webs in a spider cave underground and talk to herChanges your hairstyle and sells hair dye.
GolferMove-In Condition: Find him in the underground Desert and talk to himSells golf gear. It is purely for fun.
ZoologistMove-In Condition: Fill 10% of your Bestiary (by encountering many different enemies and critters)Sells pets and the Cat and Dog Licenses for town pets.
PainterMove-In Condition: Have 8 NPCs living with youSells paint and paintings to decorate your base.

Building Houses for NPCs

NPCs are friendly characters who sell items, heal you and help in other ways. Each one needs their own room. A room counts as a house when it has all of the following:

Walls behind it — fill the whole background with walls you placed, such as Wood Walls. Dirt walls that were already there do not count, and there cannot be any holes.
A way in — a Wooden Door on the side, or a Wooden Platform in the floor or ceiling.
A light — a Torch on the wall is enough.
A table — such as a Wooden Table or a Work Bench.
A chair — such as a Wooden Chair (a bed also works).
The right size — not too small and not too big. An easy size is 10 blocks wide and 6 blocks tall, counting the walls, floor and roof.

Not sure whether it works? Open your inventory, click the housing button (a small house icon), then click inside your room. It tells you whether the room is valid or what is missing. Build a few rooms side by side so new NPCs always have a place to move into.

NPCs and houses

Every NPC needs their own house. When you meet an NPC's requirement and there is an empty house, they move in (this can take a minute or two). The NPCs you can get right now are listed under New NPCs to look for.

Your world's ores

Every world gets only one ore from each pair, chosen when the world is created. This means you will find copper or tin, never both (although you can still get a little of the other from chests). Both ores in a pair are about equal, so it does not matter which one you have.

Copper OreorTin OreWeakest
Iron OreorLead Ore
Silver OreorTungsten Ore
Gold OreorPlatinum OreStrongest

Turn ore into bars at a Furnace, then make armor and tools at an anvil. Silver and better ores appear deeper underground. Gold or platinum armor is a good goal before your first boss.

Stage 2 of 10

Eye of Cthulhu

Reach about 200 health, make ore armor and defeat your first boss.

ActiveDone

Now you prepare for your first real boss. You will make metal armor, raise your health, set up an arena and gather potions before summoning the Eye of Cthulhu.

To do

  1. Make a full set of Gold or Platinum armor, depending on which ore your world has (or the best ore you have found).

    Dying often in Wood or Cactus armor? Make Silver or Tungsten armor first, then upgrade to Gold or Platinum later. Skip Copper, Tin, Iron and Lead armor: They give only slightly more defense than Cactus, so a full set is not worth the ore.

    Cactus armor3 def
    Copper / Tin6–7 def
    Iron / Lead9–11 def
    Silver / Tungsten13–15 def
    Gold / Platinum16–20 def
    Total defense for a full set, set bonus included.
  2. Use Life Crystals until you have at least 200 max health.
  3. Build a simple arena before the fight. See the arena box below
  4. Brew 5–10 of each buff potion you plan to use, such as Ironskin and Regeneration, plus a stack of healing potions. Keep them in a chest you only use for boss fights.

Tips

  • Once you have 200 max health, more than 10 defense and 4 NPCs, the Eye may appear on its own at night (about a 1 in 3 chance each night). You will see the message "You feel an evil presence watching you..."
  • King Slime is an easy optional boss. Use a Slime Crown to fight him for the Ninja set.
  • The Merchant moves in when you carry 50 silver and have an empty house. After he moves in, the Nurse arrives once you have 120 max health. She heals you in exchange for coins.

Bosses this stage

  • King SlimeOptionalHow to summon: Use a Slime Crown, or wait for it to appear during a Slime Rain.It hops around and teleports when it takes damage. Stand on a platform above it and keep attacking it from there.Expert & Master: Some of the slimes it releases are Spiked Slimes that shoot spikes at you, so clear them out.
  • Eye of CthulhuHow to summon: Collect 6 Lenses from Demon Eyes at night and craft a Suspicious Looking Eye at a demon altar. Use it at night, or wait for the boss to appear on its own.Build a few long platforms in the air. In its second form it loses its iris and dashes at you three times in a row: Move sideways and jump over each dash. It drops Demonite Ore or Crimtane Ore for your next set of armor.Expert & Master: It changes form at 65% health instead of 50% and releases Servants while it spins. In its second form it performs several fast dashes in a row, and near death it dashes almost constantly, so keep moving.

Start collecting early
Cell Phone

Watch for every accessory that shows information on screen (Compass, Depth Meter, Watch, Fisherman's Pocket Guide, Weather Radio, Sextant, Stopwatch, DPS Meter, Metal Detector, Radar, Lifeform Analyzer, Tally Counter). When combined with your Magic Mirror at a Tinkerer's Workshop, they become the Cell Phone: Every stat on screen plus a teleport home. It is possible to obtain it early, but it requires completing many of the Angler's fishing quests and purchasing several pieces from the Traveling Merchant.

Build a boss arena

A good arena makes every boss fight easier. Here is a simple version:

  • Build long rows of wooden platforms in the air, about 4–5 rows with a gap of around 10 blocks between them. You can jump up and drop down through them.
  • Put a Campfire and a Heart Lantern in the middle. They increase your health regeneration.
  • Add a Star in a Bottle if you use magic, so your mana regenerates faster.
  • Build it near your houses so the Nurse can heal you between fights.

Use potions before a fight

Potions give you buffs for a few minutes. Drink them just before you summon a boss.

  • Ironskin: +8 defense, so you take less damage.
  • Regeneration: Your health regenerates faster.
  • Swiftness: You run faster, which makes dodging easier.
  • Always carry healing potions as well, and eat food for the Well Fed buff.

Stage 3 of 10

Skeletron

Defeat your world's evil boss, then free the Dungeon from Skeletron.

ActiveDone

Defeating the Eye unlocks the next step: The evil boss of your world. Its drops give you a much better pickaxe and armor, and new areas such as the floating islands and the Dungeon open up.

To do

  1. Craft Shadow or Crimson armor and the Nightmare Pickaxe or Deathbringer Pickaxe. They need the Shadow Scales (Eater of Worlds) or Tissue Samples (Brain of Cthulhu) you collect from the evil boss; the ore alone is not enough. You can mine Demonite Ore or Crimtane Ore earlier with a pickaxe of at least 55% power (such as a Gold or Platinum one) and make a few items, but not this armor or pickaxe. The new pickaxe has at least 65% power, which you need to mine Hellstone later.
  2. Break a Shadow Orb or Crimson Heart to get a Musket or The Undertaker with 100 bullets. Carrying it allows the Arms Dealer to move in.
  3. Find the meteor that crashes into your world after the evil boss and mine its Meteorite. It is used for Meteor armor and the Space Gun (a strong choice for Magic).
  4. Optional: Build up to a Floating Island with Rope or platforms and open its chest. These chests contain the Starfury, Shiny Red Balloon, Lucky Horseshoe and Fledgling Wings. Be careful of fall damage.
  5. Optional: Find the Shimmer, a glowing pink pool that turns items into permanent upgrades. See the Shimmer box below

Bosses this stage

  • Eater of Worlds or Brain of CthulhuHow to summon: Use Worm Food in the Corruption or a Bloody Spine in the Crimson, or break 3 Shadow Orbs or Crimson Hearts.Eater: A giant worm that splits into smaller worms when you hit its middle, so weapons that hit many pieces work well.
    Brain: First kill the floating Creepers around it; after that, it teleports and creates fake copies. Attack the one that is not see-through.    Expert & Master:
    Eater: It is longer and faster, and its body spits Vile Spit when it is above ground.
    Brain: The Creepers charge more often and their hits give you random debuffs, and more fake Brains appear as it takes damage.
  • Queen BeeOptionalHow to summon: Use an Abeemination in the Jungle, or break the large larva in a bee hive.She dashes from side to side and shoots stingers. Keep moving up and down on platforms to dodge her dashes.Expert & Master: She performs more dashes in a row as she takes damage and fires stingers faster and faster (very fast below 10%). Her defense also increases as her health drops.
  • DeerclopsOptionalHow to summon: Use a Deer Thing in the Snow biome.It throws ice spikes along the ground and roars to shrink your view. Stay on platforms in the air and jump over the spikes.Expert & Master: Shadow hands grab at you throughout the fight, and more often as it takes damage.
  • SkeletronHow to summon: Talk to the Old Man at the Dungeon at night and choose Curse.Skeletron is a giant skull with two hands. Destroy the hands first if you can, then focus on the head. When the head starts spinning, move away quickly. Do not fight it during the day, because it becomes deadly.Expert & Master: The head shoots homing skulls once a hand is destroyed, and it is much tougher while its hands are alive, so break the hands first. The spin attack is also much faster.

The Shimmer

Shimmer is a glowing pink liquid found in a small hidden biome called the Aether. Many items thrown into it turn into something new. It is the only way to obtain some permanent upgrades.

  • Where: deep in the caverns near the far edge of your world, on the opposite side from the Dungeon (the Jungle side), close to the ocean.
  • Careful: falling into it makes you sink through blocks. Jump out quickly, or you will fall a long way.
  • Bonus: crafted items break back down into their ingredients, and some items change into others. A few only work after Skeletron, Golem or the Moon Lord.

Permanent upgrades from the Shimmer

Each one can be used once per character, and its effect is permanent.

Vital CrystalHealth regenerates fasterShimmer a Life Crystal
Arcane CrystalMana regenerates fasterShimmer a Mana Crystal
Aegis Fruit+4 defenseShimmer a Life Fruit (Hardmode)
Galaxy PearlSlightly more LuckShimmer a Pink Pearl (2.5% when you open an Oyster)
Gummy Worm+3 fishing powerShimmer a Gold Worm (a rare critter; catch it with a bug net)
Ambrosia5% faster mining and buildingShimmer almost any fruit, such as an Apple

Stage 4 of 10

Wall of Flesh

Collect strong gear from the Underworld, then defeat the Wall of Flesh to unlock Hardmode.

ActiveDone

This stage takes you to the Underworld at the bottom of the map. You will gather Hellstone for strong gear, build a long bridge, and then fight the Wall of Flesh.

To do

  1. Loot the Dungeon now that Skeletron is gone. Collect Golden Keys from Dungeon enemies and use them to open the locked gold chests. They hold great loot: The Muramasa, Cobalt Shield, Aqua Scepter, Magic Missile, Blue Moon, Valor and Handgun, and one chest holds the Shadow Key for the Shadow Chests in the Underworld. Also look for the Water Bolt on a bookshelf.
  2. Go to the Underworld (the bottom of the map) and mine about 200 Hellstone (enough for Molten armor and a Molten Pickaxe). Wear an Obsidian Skull so the hot blocks do not burn you. Also drink an Obsidian Skin Potion: it lets you swim in lava without taking damage, so you can dig out a lot of Hellstone at once, even from inside lava lakes.
  3. Find a Ruined House in the Underworld and open its Shadow Chest with the Shadow Key from the Dungeon. These chests contain valuable loot, such as the Lava Charm and Sunfury.
  4. Turn Hellstone and Obsidian into Hellstone Bars at a Hellforge, then make Molten armor and a Molten Pickaxe.
  5. Get the strongest weapon for your class. Melee players can combine 4 swords into the Night's Edge; the setups show the best choice for the other classes.
  6. Build a long bridge of platforms across the Underworld, because the Wall chases you from one side to the other. Wooden platforms are fine on Classic. Use Stone Platforms instead of wood: Lava Slimes leave lava behind when they die, and lava burns away wooden platforms. Obsidian and Ash Wood platforms are also safe.
  7. Optional: Protect parts of your world before Hardmode. Dig shafts about 5 blocks wide from the surface all the way down to the Underworld on both sides of areas you want to keep safe, such as your base or the Jungle. The Corruption, Crimson and Hallow can only spread to blocks within 3 tiles, so they cannot cross these gaps. It is easier to dig now, because cavern enemies are much weaker before Hardmode. When Hardmode starts, a new stripe of Hallow and Corruption or Crimson appears in a random place, so a protected area can still be hit.

Bosses this stage

  • Wall of FleshHow to summon: Collect a Guide Voodoo Doll from Voodoo Demons in the Underworld, then throw the doll into lava.The wall moves across the entire Underworld, so run along your stone bridge and keep attacking the eyes and mouth. Kill the Hungry mouths that grab you. Defeating it starts Hardmode. Its Treasure Bag contains a Demon Heart: use it to unlock a 6th accessory slot. Its Treasure Bag contains a Demon Heart: use it to unlock a 7th accessory slot.Expert & Master: It moves faster (speeding up at 66%, 33% and 5% health), the eyes fire lasers more often, and it keeps spawning extra Hungries.

Stage 5 of 10

Mechanical Bosses

Collect Hardmode ores and wings, then defeat the three mechanical bosses.

ActiveDone
Congratulations, you are in Hardmode!You defeated the Wall of Flesh. Your world now has new ores, tougher enemies and two new biomes, the Hallow and the stronger Corruption or Crimson. The second half of the game starts here.

In this stage you will smash altars for new ores, get your first wings, and then face the three mechanical bosses.

To do

  1. Collect the Pwnhammer from the Wall of Flesh. Use it to smash at least 3 demon or crimson altars: Each one adds new ore to your world. Smashing more altars adds even more ore, but each set of three adds less than the set before, and every altar you smash summons 1–2 Wraiths.
  2. Make armor from the best new ore you have. The ores come in this order: Cobalt or Palladium, then Mythril or Orichalcum, then Adamantite or Titanium. Your world only gets one ore from each pair: The first three altars you smash decide which ones.
  3. Craft your first wings. Kill Wyverns in the sky for Soul of Flight and combine them with Feathers and Souls at a Mythril Anvil.
  4. Optional: Fight Mimics in the underground. In Hardmode, some chests in the caverns are Mimics that jump at you when you get close. Defeat them to collect great loot: The Cross Necklace, Philosopher's Stone, Star Cloak, Titan Glove, Magic Dagger or Dual Hook.
  5. Optional: Fight the biome Mimics. Craft a Key of Light from 15 Souls of Light or a Key of Night from 15 Souls of Night at a work bench, then place it alone in an empty chest (any chest works) to turn the chest into a Mimic. The Key of Light makes a Hallowed Mimic, and the Key of Night makes a Corrupt or Crimson Mimic (whichever your world has). Each one guarantees one item of great loot:
    Hallowed Mimic: Daedalus Stormbow, Flying Knife, Crystal Vile Shard or Illuminant Hook.
    Corrupt Mimic: Dart Rifle, Clinger Staff, Chain Guillotines, Putrid Scent or Worm Hook.
    Crimson Mimic: Dart Pistol, Life Drain, Fetid Baghnakhs, Flesh Knuckles or Tendon Hook.

Tips

  • Build a larger arena in the sky with many platforms. Hardmode bosses move quickly.
  • Watch out for Angry Nimbus clouds when it rains, and for Mimics underground.

Bosses this stage

  • Queen SlimeOptionalHow to summon: Collect a Gelatin Crystal from the underground Hallow and use it.In the second half of the fight she flies and slams down on you, so keep moving and stay out from under her.
  • The TwinsHow to summon: Collect Souls of Light from enemies in the underground Hallow and Souls of Night from enemies in the underground Corruption or Crimson. Craft a Mechanical Eye and use it at night. All three mechanical summons are made from these souls.There are two eyes: Retinazer shoots lasers, and Spazmatism spits cursed fire at close range. Defeat one at a time and keep running in one direction. They fly away if the sun rises.Expert & Master: Retinazer fires lasers faster as it takes damage and about twice as fast in its second form. Spazmatism's dashes are quicker.
  • The DestroyerHow to summon: Craft a Mechanical Worm and use it at night.It is a giant metal worm, so piercing weapons that hit many pieces work very well. Its small probes shoot lasers, so keep moving.
  • Skeletron PrimeHow to summon: Craft a Mechanical Skull and use it at night.It is a metal Skeletron with four weapon arms. Break the arms first to make the fight easier, then attack the head. Like the Twins, it leaves at sunrise.Expert & Master: Its spin attack is about 3 times faster, and it moves faster overall.

New NPCs to look for

WizardMove-In Condition: Find him tied up in the caverns and talk to himSells the Crystal Ball and other magic items.
Tax CollectorMove-In Condition: Use Purification Powder on a Tortured Soul in the UnderworldCollects rent from your NPCs; talk to him to receive it.
TruffleMove-In Condition: Build a house inside a glowing mushroom biome on the surfaceSells the Autohammer, which makes Shroomite Bars.
PirateMove-In Condition: Defeat a Pirate InvasionSells cannons and pirate items.
SteampunkerMove-In Condition: Defeat any mechanical bossSells the Clentaminator, which spreads or removes biomes.

Useful gear

Tools that make building, fishing and exploring easier. A gold outline marks the best pick.

Must-have
Shellphoneor Cell Phone + Magic Conch

Combine the Cell Phone, the Magic Conch and the Demon Conch (a rare catch when fishing in lava) at a Tinkerer's Workshop to make one item that teleports you home, to the ocean or to the Underworld.

Mimic Hook

Collect a strong hook from Hardmode Mimics. Any of them is better than the pre-Hardmode hooks.

Rod of Discord

Teleports you to your cursor, which lets you dodge almost any attack. Collect it from Chaos Elementals in the underground Hallow (0.2%0.25% chance each). Using it again too soon damages you, so wait for the Chaos State debuff to end.

Stage 6 of 10

Plantera

Make Hallowed gear, mine Chlorophyte and defeat Plantera in the Jungle.

ActiveDone

With the mechanical bosses defeated, you can make Hallowed and Chlorophyte gear. This stage ends with Plantera, deep in the underground Jungle.

To do

  1. Craft Hallowed armor from the Hallowed Bars you collect from the mechanical bosses. It is a strong choice for every class.
  2. Craft a Drax from Hallowed Bars and one Soul of Fright, Might and Sight (a Pickaxe Axe works the same way). With it, you can mine green Chlorophyte Ore in the underground Jungle.
  3. Craft Chlorophyte armor or weapons. They are a major upgrade.
  4. Eat Life Fruit from the underground Jungle until you have 500 max health. Each one gives 5 more.

Tips

  • Bring your best potions for Plantera. It is one of the hardest fights in the game.

Bosses this stage

  • Duke FishronOptionalHow to summon: Fish in the Ocean with a Truffle Worm as bait.He is fast and dashes often. Stay over the ocean: If you leave it, he becomes much stronger.Expert & Master: Below 15% health he enters a third phase with unpredictable teleport-dashes (this never happens on Classic). His dashes are also faster.
  • PlanteraHow to summon: Break a pink Plantera's Bulb in the underground Jungle. The bulbs grow after all three mechanical bosses are defeated.Plantera is a large flower that grabs onto walls with hooks. When its health is low, it grows teeth and becomes much faster. Dig a long, flat tunnel in the Jungle so you can keep running.Expert & Master: In its second form, extra tentacles grow from its hooks and keep returning. It shoots poison seeds twice as often.

Stage 9 of 10

Moon Lord

Destroy the four Celestial Pillars and defeat the Moon Lord.

ActiveDone

Defeating the Cultist calls four Celestial Pillars into your world. Destroying all of them summons the final boss: The Moon Lord.

To do

  1. Collect fragments from each pillar, such as Solar Fragment and Nebula Fragment, and craft your class's powerful new weapons at the Ancient Manipulator, which you collect from the Lunatic Cultist.

Tips

  • Build a large arena with many rows of platforms, a campfire and a heart lantern. Bring your best potions and food.

Bosses this stage

  • The Celestial PillarsHow to summon: Defeat the Lunatic Cultist. Four Celestial Pillars then appear around your world.Kill the enemies around each one to break its shield, then destroy the pillar.
  • Moon LordHow to summon: Destroy all four Celestial Pillars. He appears about a minute later.Attack the eyes on his hands, then the eye on his head, then the heart on his chest. When the head charges its large death laser, move out of the way.

Build a boss arena

A good arena makes every boss fight easier. Here is a simple version:

  • Build long rows of wooden platforms in the air, about 4–5 rows with a gap of around 10 blocks between them. You can jump up and drop down through them.
  • Put a Campfire and a Heart Lantern in the middle. They increase your health regeneration.
  • Add a Star in a Bottle if you use magic, so your mana regenerates faster.
  • Build it near your houses so the Nurse can heal you between fights.

Stage 10 of 10

Endgame

With the Moon Lord defeated, you can now make the best gear in the game.

ActiveDone
Congratulations, you beat Terraria!You defeated the Moon Lord, the final boss. Every item in the game is now within your reach.

This last stage covers the final upgrades: Armor made from the Moon Lord's Luminite, and the best weapon in the game.

To do

  1. The Moon Lord drops Luminite. Turn it into Luminite Bars and make the endgame armor for your class.
  2. Craft the Zenith. It is the strongest weapon in the game, and it is so good that it is worth making no matter which class you play.

What to do next?

Start a new world with a different class or a harder difficulty, try one of the secret world seeds, or build something impressive in this world. There is always more to discover.
